description: For each latitude/longitude, find the country, its state/province/region (ISO 3166-2) and, in the US, the county (FIPS). Works offline. With map set, also draws a map of how many points fall in each area (regions of the main country, US counties, or countries). Returns one line per point (country › region › county); to pin each point on a map instead use generate_pin_map.

map.description: Also draw a map of counts per area: auto picks the finest level that fits; leave out for text only.

points.description: The points, each with latitude, longitude and an optional name.

title.description: Title of the map (only with map).

name: locate_points
title: Find the region of each point
